Welcome aboard

The Dock is a family run café and restaurant that is perfect for everyone: celebrating something special, or catching up with friends over coffee or cocktails. The setting is informal and relaxed, and the food is sourced from across Devon and Cornwall.

  • Two al fresco balcony dining areas with a view over the marina.
  • Locally sourced and created food, served by a friendly team.
  • In the heart of Plymouth's Coastal Quarter in Millbay.

Reserve a table

Call The Dock to reserve. Parties of seven or more should always call.

01752 253 555
  • Bookings are allocated up to 2 hours. The Dock does its best to meet seating requests and longer stays, but it may not always be possible.
  • The Dock's online booking asks for card details. A £5 per guest charge applies if a booking is cancelled within 24 hours and the table cannot be re-sold, or if guests do not arrive.
  • To change a booking, contact The Dock directly. To avoid a charge, cancel by email with at least 24 hours' notice.
ahoy@thedockplymouth.co.ukOr book online on The Dock's own booking page
